deployments_detail.use: Supermicro demonstrated a customer-service application built with the NVIDIA AI Blueprint for digital humans at its booth/expanded AI portfolio launch (Jan 2025), showcasing a conversational AI agent on its own edge/enterprise servers. [NVIDIA (AI Blueprint / digital humans)]
AI GPU servers + liquid-cooled SuperClusters (NVIDIA Blackwell) for AI/GenAI infrastructure

SuperCloud Composer, Supermicro's data-center management platform, embeds a data-rich analytics engine providing predictive analytics and intelligent monitoring across compute/network/power to automate deployment, provisioning and repurposing of infrastructure. AI/ML feature shipped in Supermicro's own product. [Supermicro (in-house)]

Data Center Building Block Solutions (DCBBS), a new Supermicro business line launched Oct 2025, delivers modular AI infrastructure with deployment automation and developer tools to design, order and build complete AI data centers from validated components. [Supermicro (in-house)]

SuperCloud Automation Center (SCAC) provides pre-built enterprise automation for data-center and edge infrastructure, including AI workload enablement/onboarding, firmware baselining, OS setup and Kubernetes integration. Launched as part of the DCBBS business line. [Supermicro (in-house)]

Automated L11 cluster testing and burn-in (R-Burn/S-Burn) quality assurance in Supermicro's own rack-scale integration factories, validating integration quality and hardware before shipment. Automated inspection/validation in manufacturing operations. [Supermicro (in-house)]
